stages.log: Pirates took the Fleet tender's stores pod. Bring it home, and the Fleet remembers who did. The tender's stolen stores pod: marked on the chart, from the next sector on. Her bosun would sign on, given a berth.

objectives.text: Tag it for the Fleet, or Tag it, sign on Varga
objectives.done-when: events.chose(event: storespod, choice: tag) or events.chose(event: storespod, choice: tagjoin)

stages.fail-when: events.chose(event: storespod, choice: strip) or run.past-charts
stages.why: It went cold: strip what's left.
